purpose: Document the repository structure and distinguish existing paths from planned architecture.

baseline.note: The verified_at date records the original baseline inspection. The existing_paths and existing_directories lists describe the repository structure represented by this manifest revision. Verify every listed path on the feature branch before merging. Update this manifest through a pull request whenever repository structure changes.

rules: Every required file must exist and must not be empty.
Every path listed as existing must be verified against the repository.
Planned paths must not be treated as required until formally adopted.
Manifest changes must be reviewed through a pull request.
Governance documents marked proposed must not be represented as ratified.
Documentation paths listed as existing must be present on the branch before merge.

governance.change_control: Pull request review and applicable main-branch protection rules

maintenance.update_policy: Update this manifest in the same pull request that changes the repository structure.
